changelog:
🧭 A guided Add account dialog: AWS Builder ID as one recommended card, the other seven ways in one list, and step-by-step checklists for the Builder ID, IAM Identity Center and Microsoft sign-ins.
🧪 The account tester runs several models at once from a searchable picker and shows each model's status, latency and credits.
👤 A new account detail sheet: the summary first, actions in its header, a 24-hour activity chart and settings you edit in place.
📜 A new request detail sheet titled by its model, with the whole request in one card and errors as a readable notice.
📊 A redesigned Overview: KPI cards, traffic against the previous hour, what needs attention, traffic by account, the model mix and the most active accounts.
🌗 A lifted near-black dark theme, one type and spacing scale, flatter toasts and a 10-row page size.
🔔 Updates show in the sidebar card and bell; Help & docs and Report an issue sit in the Admin menu.
⚙️ Settings get a Models group in the section nav, and one-switch cards save as you flip them.
🌐 Server errors are translated through stable error codes, and the pt-BR, vi and zh texts were reviewed.
🔧 Fixed: tokens that expire before the next sweep are renewed in time.
🔧 Fixed: a backup schedule whose last run is in the future runs again.
🔧 Fixed: requests name the fixed Builder ID profile, and the proxy follows Kiro's client-version gate (KiroIDE 1.4.121).
